title: Scattering in the Energy Space for Solutions of the Damped Nonlinear Schrödinger Equation on Rd×T
content: We will show, in any space dimension d≥1, the decay and scattering in the energy space for the solution to the damped nonlinear Schrödinger equation posed on Rd×T and initial data in H1(Rd×T). We will derive also new bilinear Morawetz identities and corresponding localized Morawetz estimates.
